record_type_quote: Multiple laboratories carried out 12 direct replication studies, including one MTurk study.

targets.title: Learning about what others were doing: Verb aspect and attributions of mundane and criminal intent for past actions
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 3, which is the focus of this RRR, showed that grammatical aspect influences perceived intentionality for both mundane and criminal behavior.
targets.outcome_quote: The results of this large-scale, multilab direct replication of Experiment 3 by Hart and Albarracín (2011) are not consistent with the original result that actions described in imperfective aspect are considered to be more intentional than actions described in perfective aspect.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report states the multilab replication is inconsistent with the original and fails to find the detail-processing and mediation effects as well.

reasoning: Completed coordinated new-sample replication of one original paper, Experiment 3. Laboratories are not distinct original targets. Full article title and author list match the assignment; references present.
